headline: Japan sounds the alarm: 10-year bond hits record highs
summary: Japanese government debt is under renewed pressure after industrial production rebounded and Bank of Japan minutes reinforced the possibility of further policy tightening. The 10-year bond hit record highs.
why: The 10-year Japanese government bond is the benchmark for Japanese borrowing costs and influences global yields. Shifts in Bank of Japan policy expectations affect yen carry trades and global rate markets.
why_moved: Industrial production rebounded and Bank of Japan minutes raised the possibility of further policy tightening, adding pressure to Japanese government bonds.
